functions.tag: {title:"The Heartwood Codex",author:"A Fallen Warden",pages:['{"text": "The Heartwood Codex\\n\\nBefore the Hollow Deep was sealed, a grove was planted around a single living heart. It was meant to keep the dark in check."}','{"text": "The grove grew faithful, then hungry. Its roots learned to walk and its branches learned to reach."}','{"text": "Those who cut the heart free found it still beating. They left it to guard the ore that glows with its own pulse."}','{"text": "If you read this, the Heart is silent. Take the hollowite. Do not wake what sleeps beneath the roots."}']}
